context: Page in SQL with LIMIT/OFFSET rather than rendering then hiding, so cold-load transfer is not disturbed. Add a free-text filter over platform, version and public ID. Support cross-page selection through the picking owner. State export scope in the UI and in the QA doc. Decide the scratchpad's treatment explicitly and record it.
description:
Query currently renders TABLE_RENDER_LIMIT (200) rows with a 'Show more results' control (Query.tsx:233-240, 936-945) and reaches 13,970px at desktop, 14,386px at 390px. It is progressive rather than unbounded - Compare is the unbounded one - but it is still browsed by scrollbar and has no free-text search.

Two scope decisions must be made explicitly rather than left implicit: what CSV/JSON export covers once the table is paged (today it exports 'visible columns'), and whether the SQL scratchpad's own client-rendered table (Query.tsx:951-1013) is bounded here or declared out of scope.

anti_patterns.why: the standard fixture is 11 results and cannot exercise large-corpus behaviour

anti_patterns.dont: claim a scale improvement using the default 11-result fixture

anti_patterns.instead: make worktree-create BRANCH=... WORKTREE_PATH=... then make agent-write-preflight
anti_patterns.why: AGENTS.md makes the primary clone read-only for agents

anti_patterns.dont: leave export scope implicit under paging
anti_patterns.instead: state whether export covers the page, the filter, or the whole corpus
anti_patterns.why: 'visible columns' becomes ambiguous the moment rows are paged

anti_patterns.dont: render all rows then hide them with CSS
anti_patterns.why: rendering-then-hiding keeps the document tall and defeats the purpose
